evidence: games/hytale/README.md (What works, what doesn't: Hytale server 0.7.7, with a real Hytale client through hosted Takaro)
games/hytale/scripts/test.sh (contract level, every build: the plugin's unit tests over argument handling, bans, catalogues, map tiles and reconnect)
support.notes: The connector is one Java plugin jar in the server's mods/ folder; it holds the Takaro connection itself, no sidecar. It compiles against com.hypixel.hytale:Server 0.7.7 from Hypixel's Maven repository and is never shipped with it. The Hytale server needs its Assets.zip and a Hytale account login, neither of which a hosted runner can have, so release verification is contract level and every server version needs a live retest before it is declared.

notes: The plugin is compiled once with Maven inside the pinned Temurin 25 image (the 0.7.7 server is Java 25 bytecode). The Hytale server jar is fetched by SHA-256 for compilation only and is never part of a release.
